text:
Situation: Ifosfamide injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2026-06-12 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. The shortage covers Baxter Healthcare, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and SteriMax Inc. Our three sites use Hikma's 50 mg/mL 60 mL vial (NDC 0143-9530-01) from the THYMOORGAN PHARMAZIE GmbH plant. Corvale East has 2.6 days on hand (9 vials at 3.5 vials/day), Corvale General has 14.4 days (41 vials at 2.9 vials/day), and Corvale Lakeside has 26.5 days (19 vials at 0.7 vials/day). Alternate presentations are available at each site.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows ifosfamide injection as Current with initial posting 2026-06-12 and updates through October 2026 for the four manufacturers listed above.

Our position: Supply is critically low at Corvale East. Corvale Lakeside holds sufficient stock to support a transfer without jeopardizing its own supply. P&T-approved alternatives exist for both Hikma 50 mg/mL and Baxter 1 g/20 mL presentations.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 8 vials of ifosfamide 50 mg/mL 60 mL from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Use Hikma 50 mg/mL vial as P&T-approved alternative (approved 2026-09-15) — requires pharmacist verification and dose recalculation.
3. Use Baxter 1 g/20 mL vial as P&T-approved alternative (approved 2026-04-18) — requires pharmacist verification and dose recalculation.

Not recommended: No additional actions at this time.
